title: Patient->Case->Rx loop broken in web UI
detail: No case selector and no way to attach patient files to an Rx in the web; API supported both. Minimal UI added on this branch.

title: Patients beyond first API page unreachable
detail: RxCreate loaded only the first 25 patients with no search. Added type-ahead filter bound to searchPatients.

title: Truncated ASCII STL accepted as format_ok
detail: Validation only checked solid+facet prefixes; now requires endfacet+endsolid. Backend regression added.

title: 2FA browser specs non-idempotent
detail: Specs enrolled TOTP onto shared doctor@pa.dev; rerun always failed. Replaced with seeded mfa@pa.dev fixed synthetic secret.

title: No pagination UI on patient/Rx/inbox lists
detail: First API page only; search/filters mitigate. Needs cursor controls before multi-hundred-record clinics.

title: Tooth entry is a numbered grid not an FDI chart
detail: Works and persists, but below EasyRx charting ergonomics.

title: Non-STL attachment paths unverified
detail: Upload/attach accept arbitrary files; only STL bundle path was verified end-to-end.

title: Rendering-field change -> new bundle not browser-verified
detail: Reuse on unchanged content verified; change-detection exists in code but a patient-name-style change was not re-verified.

title: Dev database carried pre-idempotency UAT-P03B duplicates
detail: ensureDataset keys on external_ref so tests are unaffected; clean via fresh seed if desired.
